verifications.claim: Starting in December 2026, the U.S. will automatically register men aged 18–26 for the military draft using existing federal data.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'change is set to take effect by December 2026' 'males between the ages of 18 and 25'; R2: 'take effect by December' 'males between the ages of 18 and 25'; R4: 'by December 2026' 'males between 18 and 25'
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for automatic registration by Dec 2026 using federal data, but age range specified as 18-25 (with late reg to 26), not precisely 18-26.

verifications.claim: The change from mandatory self-registration to automatic enrollment is part of the Fiscal Year 2026 National Defense Authorization Act.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'part of the 2026 National Defense Authorization Act'; R2: 'mandated by defense policy legislation passed by Congress last year'; R4: 'new rule passed by Congress last year'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly attributed to the FY2026 NDAA across sources.

verifications.claim: The U.S. remains an all-volunteer force.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'has not conducted a military draft since the Vietnam War era'; R2: 'has since relied on an all-volunteer force'; R4: 'moved to an all-volunteer military in 1973'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm no draft since 1973, all-volunteer force.

verifications.claim: There is no active military draft in 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'automatic registration does not itself mean a draft is imminent'; R2: 'last activated the draft in 1973'; R4: 'ended conscription... in 1973'
verifications.reasoning: Sources unanimously state no active draft currently or in 2026.

verifications.claim: The Selective Service System will pull data from other agencies (such as the DMV or Social Security Administration) to register eligible men automatically.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'pulling from existing federal data sources' 'direct integration with federal databases'; R2: 'pulling data from existing databases'; R4: 'integration with federal data sources'
verifications.reasoning: Supports pulling from federal data/databases, but specific agencies like DMV (state) or SSA not named.

verifications.claim: Males between the ages of 18 and 25 (who are citizens or immigrants) will be enrolled.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R4: 'most males between the ages of 18 and 25'; R2: 'U.S. citizenship for immigrants'
verifications.reasoning: Exact age range 18-25; immigrants implied as required to register.

verifications.evidence: R1: 'denied federal student loans'; R2: 'disqualification from student loans'; R4: 'disqualify you from student loans'

verifications.claim: Failure to register can still lead to disqualification from federal job training.

verifications.claim: Failure to register can still lead to disqualification from federal jobs.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: A draft would require a separate, authorized act of Congress and the President’s signature.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Congress and the president authorize conscription'; R4: 'Congress and the president authorize a military draft'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm draft requires Congressional and Presidential action.

verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: R3 mentions Army raising enlistment age limit but provides no specifics on 42 or April 2026.
